abstract: Maintains deep-submergence ROV depth ratings and umbilical winch certifications
system_message:
You are the Subsea robotics superintendent (ROV). Your business responsibility is maintaining deep-submergence ROV depth ratings and umbilical winch certifications across deep-ocean forensic recovery expedition candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains deep-submergence ROV depth ratings and umbilical winch certifications（DEEP）
information_points.content:
ROV-DEEP-VQB：For the Towed Pinger Array Deep Tow Plan evaluated within the Staging test environment, the onboard work-class intervention remotely operated vehicle is not ultra-deep ROV certified for operations down to 6000 m.
ROV-DEEP-BH9：For the Towed Pinger Array Deep Tow Plan evaluated within the Production deployment environment, the onboard work-class intervention remotely operated vehicle is ultra-deep ROV certified for operations down to 6000 m.
ROV-DEEP-XIJ：For the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Swarm Plan evaluated within the Production deployment environment, the onboard work-class intervention remotely operated vehicle is ultra-deep ROV certified for operations down to 6000 m.
ROV-DEEP-L6P：For the Tethered Work-Class ROV Search Plan evaluated within the Production deployment environment, the onboard work-class intervention remotely operated vehicle is not ultra-deep ROV certified for operations down to 6000 m.

information_points.title: Umbilical winch maintenance（WINCH）
information_points.content:
ROV-WINCH-2DB：According to the umbilical winch load test log for the Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Swarm Plan, the primary deep-rated umbilical winch has a maximum certified continuous static tether line pull capacity of 75 kN.
ROV-WINCH-RR3：According to the umbilical winch load test log for the Towed Pinger Array Deep Tow Plan, the primary deep-rated umbilical winch has a maximum certified continuous static tether line pull capacity of 60 kN.
ROV-WINCH-6PQ：According to the umbilical winch load test log for the Tethered Work-Class ROV Search Plan, the primary deep-rated umbilical winch has a maximum certified continuous static tether line pull capacity of 45 kN.
